Ashely Poker II: dialogue guide

Written 2026-11-16 04:56 from the game's own files · 2966 of 2966 lines written · regenerate with python -P -E tooling/art_sort/art_sort.py guide ~/OneDrive/Documents/invoke-remote-tool/data/sorted/ashely2 (Put in the game does it too)

Using this

  • Each card is one dialogue start. Open its File in Godot (double-click it in the FileSystem dock) to get the dialogue editor, and find the Start node by its id. The start nodes run down the left edge in the order shown here, and the editor position is given too.
  • Each line node picks its picture with a background list and a background (picture). The Picture column shows what each line shows now, as list · picture. "Same picture" means the line keeps the one before.
  • Grey italic lines are still placeholders. Write over them in Godot, or on the sort board (the preview's text box), which Put in the game carries over while the scene is untouched in Godot. Once you change a scene in Godot it is yours: Put in the game only adds pictures to its list and tells you which ones no line shows yet.
  • "Not used yet" (dashed outline) marks pictures in a scene's list that no line shows. A thick outline marks a placeholder picture.
  • Close Godot before running Put in the game.

How the scene runs

  • A race of short poker matches. Take 4 stakes and she forfeits; lose 4 matches and you forfeit (the naked run).
  • Ashely's text (a phone message) → Intro → First Hand (one life each; she always wins with four aces) → First Forfeit (what she makes you do) → Match → Won Match (you pick a stake) or Lost Match (her punishment) → Match → … → Ending → the phone, where Amy's meetup is offered next.
  • After each match you win, the menu offers each ladder's next rung. Strip: top → topless walk → shorts → panties. Sexy: butt → breasts → under your clothes → the blowjob finale. Love: truth → two nice things → real smile → real kiss. The mini-routes add or replace options.
  • Most stakes have a version for what she has on: dressed, topless (shorts on), or in her panties.
  • Two sexy finales unlock across races and show on the menu as a locked row ("? ? ?") until then: the sex scene (beside the blowjob finale) and the topless blowjob (at rung 3 once her top is off).
  • The menu marks each stake by how much of it you have seen: New, Seen 1 of 3 (it plays a different scene for what she has on, and her inspection counts for each touch), Seen all, or Locked.
  • A stake scene plays the same whichever of your four stakes it is. A scene that can be your last stake or an earlier one gets two optional sign-offs, starts of their own played right after it: …__NEXT when the race goes on, …__LAST when that was your 4th stake. An unwritten one (only its placeholder line) never plays.
  • Her punishments, in order: "kiss my ass" → the dick pic → your walk or the bench girl. Her 4th win is your forfeit.
  • Finish a ladder with your 4th stake and the race ends over that finale's last picture (THE_END__…). Otherwise the ending is the wrap for what she has on (FINAL__…).

Still open

  • Pictures to pick: INTRO_WAGER 01 isn't shown by any line yet. INTRO_FORFEIT has no pictures of its own yet: its placeholder line shows the dressed table. LOSE_P3A_YOUR_WALK's one picture is a 1920×1080 stand-in.
  • Music: none of the seven stages has any yet (startingMusic / randomMusic in their gs_*.tres).
  • Not in the game: June's phone scene (PHONE_BENCH_GIRL, row 36). It's a phone text chat (a phoneScript plus her contact picture), not a dialogue here. Her number is already kept when you win after the bench girl. Also not in: the MR1 follow-up menu (open questions in docs/TODO.md).
  • To check: WIN_L1_TRUTH__PANTIES 02 and 03 are the same pictures as the shorts-on WIN_L3_SMILE__TOP_OFF 07 and 02. WIN_MR3_INSPECT (any outfit) and LOSE_P3B_BENCH_GIRL (dressed or topless) have one list each, so their pictures shouldn't show her outfit.
  • Your call: which pictures, if any, should unlock wallpapers?

The stage opens here. In the intro this is the intro itself, picked from the phone's events once Ashely's text (ashely2_phone, offered after Anna's night) has been read. The Rematch With Ashely checkpoint lands on the phone with that text waiting; in the other stages it only routes on.
